name: Blood Tithe

angles.text: As a Skyborne farmer, Alvarion Windfield suffers and calls desperately for aid. His hardship shows what Skyborne face beyond Valanaar.

faq.answer: Alvarion Windfield is a Skyborne farmer in Valanaar who seeks fighters to protect his home. Though severe pain troubles him, he sends travelers to his wife, Aamelia, at their orchard.
The Windfield Orchard lies in the lowlands west of Valanaar. Alvarion directs travelers there to find his wife, Aamelia Windfield, who oversees the farm's defense.
faq.q: Where is the Windfield Orchard located?

faq.answer: Alvarion's affliction is unknown when travelers meet him. Intense, debilitating pain troubles him as he speaks, lending urgency to his plea for help.
Aamelia Windfield is Alvarion's wife and tends their family orchard west of Valanaar. He sends willing travelers to help her defend their land.
Alvarion Windfield seeks help in Valanaar for his struggling farm. He asks you to find his wife, Aamelia, at their lowland orchard.
faq.q: What is the task in Blood Tithe?

aliases: where does blood tithe take place
faq.answer: Valanaar is a settlement where travelers and Skyborne gather. Alvarion comes there seeking capable fighters to save his orchard from peril.

sections.body: Alvarion Windfield has come from his homestead to Valanaar in search of capable fighters. Pain leaves him visibly injured, and he fears for the livelihood his farm provides. He asks you to travel west into the lowlands, where his wife Aamelia tends their family orchard.
sections.title: A Plea in Valanaar

sections.body: The Windfield Orchard lies in the lowlands west of Valanaar. Alvarion is too ill to tend the farm, so Aamelia Windfield bears its burdens alone. Reach the western valley, learn what threatens the orchard, and lend the family your strength.
sections.title: Trouble in the Lowlands

summary: In Valanaar, Alvarion Windfield seeks aid for the orchard that sustains his family. Pain keeps the Skyborne farmer from his work, so he sends travelers west to his wife, Aamelia, who tends their lowland farm.
